manifests.goal: Freeze all source digests, research claims, hypotheses, gaps, bibliography provenance and supported boundaries.
boundedWork: Recompute S0-S5 hashes and archive external-source provenance.
Resolve external citations to primary URL or DOI and mark unresolved items UNVERIFIED.
Freeze the supported Kotlin contour, forbidden claims and branch-code registry inputs.
Materialize the bounded untested cross-language specification scaffold required by S4 questions 25-26.
Materialize a synthetic-data clickable offline evidence-view prototype for later Q03 refinement.
nonGoals: No product implementation, corpus generation, benchmark execution or threshold change.
manifests.expectedEvidenceDelta: Every mandatory source claim has a falsifier, destination node, evidence class and verified provenance status.
verificationCommands: ruby -ryaml -e 'ARGV.each { |path| YAML.safe_load(File.read(path), aliases: false) }' docs/research/codeclew/hypotheses.yaml docs/research/codeclew/gap-register.yaml
independentVerifierChecks: Recompute every source digest and verify HEAD provenance.
Check all 32 DR2 questions, 22 deliverables and T00-T23 in both trace directions.
Confirm that unresolved literature is UNVERIFIED and cannot support a gate.
Verify that the cross-language scaffold is bounded to declared observables and explicitly forbids universal transpilation claims.
Exercise the offline prototype clickable provenance, Unknown and freshness paths with synthetic data.

retryPolicy.noProgressRule: same failure fingerprint twice without accepted evidence delta

manifests.passPredicate: All S0-S5 digests match, mandatory mappings are bidirectionally complete, no UNVERIFIED source supports a gate claim, and the bounded scaffold plus clickable synthetic prototype pass their source-level checks.

manifests.goal: Publish and negatively test execution-time evidence, telemetry, budget, event-clock and experiment-integrity contracts.
boundedWork: Create NodeContract-v1, EvidencePacket and VerificationReceipt schemas and validator.
Freeze outcome, branch-code, retry, invalidation and conditional-join semantics.
Freeze native token, preprocessing, event-clock, compute and full-team cost accounting.
Freeze exact statistical estimands, non-inferiority margin, missing-data, exclusions and budgets.
Freeze corpus-commitment, final-system-lock, X04-only H12 decision and exact GF 1-32/1-22 report contracts.
nonGoals: No semantic kernel, editing transform, conflict detector or benchmark outcome.
manifests.expectedEvidenceDelta: All descendant runs become schema-valid, cost-complete and unable to unlock a successor with a verified negative outcome.

Check every DOT edge outcome and branch-code set against its source vocabulary.
Reject corpus reveal before final lock, non-X04 H12 decisions, and incomplete GF answer or deliverable sets.

manifests.goal: Verify the current Codeclew baseline, map reuse and gaps, and make a measurement-backed storage decision without adding product code.
boundedWork: Run clean baseline verification and map every project.md requirement to current evidence.
Classify required capabilities as reuse, extend or replace with code links.
Measure representative index, query, update, rebuild, storage and recovery workloads.
Publish a storage ADR that defaults to current SQLite unless a frozen threshold is met.
nonGoals: No graph database, OWL service, semantic product feature or broad refactor.
manifests.expectedEvidenceDelta: Every proposed component is tied to a measured current-code gap and storage remains a falsifiable decision rather than a greenfield assumption.
independentVerifierChecks: Re-run the clean baseline suite and representative read/update/rebuild workloads.
Sample every project.md area and verify code-linked reuse or measured gap evidence.
Reject the ADR if a new operational store lacks the H13 threshold or rollback path.

retryPolicy.noProgressRule: same failure fingerprint twice without accepted evidence delta

manifests.passPredicate: The baseline suite passes from clean checkout, S0 has a complete capability-gap matrix, and the storage ADR follows measured H13 thresholds.

manifests.goal: Terminalize every exhausted bootstrap-foundation outcome set before v1 exists without unlocking implementation.
boundedWork: Wait for reachable bootstrap-wave quiescence and select the exact sorted set of accepted exhausted R01-R03 outcomes.
Recompute every parent packet and receipt digest and retain every primary and secondary cause.
Emit only SUCCESS plus INCONCLUSIVE_FOUNDATION and prove that no implementation continuation is eligible.
nonGoals: No repair, implementation, product verdict, v1 contract assumption or selection of a preferred failure cause.
manifests.expectedEvidenceDelta: A failed bootstrap becomes a verified deterministic foundation limitation instead of an unreceipted dead end.
independentVerifierChecks: Recompute the full wave-quiescent exhausted R01-R03 source set and exact parent receipt set.
Confirm deterministic normalization to INCONCLUSIVE_FOUNDATION while retaining every cause and digest.
Prove that the bootstrap terminal profile exposes only GK to GF0 and unlocks no implementation edge.
Recompute producer, verifier and prior-attempt cost totals against the frozen GK bootstrap budget.
